title: tk self-invocation pays the update check
description:
FOUND BY TICK 7o5. cmd/tk/main.go runs update.CheckPeriodically for most subcommands, including show and list. Now that tk cloud spawn invokes 'tk show --json' and 'tk list --all --json' as subprocesses, a tk self-invocation pays a network-shaped code path.

Not urgent: the check is cached and it is two calls per spawn, off any hot path. But a process invoking itself to read local state should not be consulting a release feed, and inside a sandbox with restricted egress it is a latency or failure surface for no benefit.

A TK_NO_UPDATE_CHECK-style suppression set on the child would be small and self-contained. Worth checking whether an env var for this already exists before adding one.
acceptance_criteria: A tk subprocess spawned by tk does not run the update check. Any existing suppression mechanism is reused rather than duplicated. go test ./... green.
